title: VooPoo PNP Coils
description: Voopoo’s PnP (Plug ‘n’ Play) coils are a favourite among vapers, celebrated for their remarkable versatility and compatibility across almost the entire Voopoo range of innovative vaping devices. As the name implies, replacing a PnP coil is as simple as ‘unplugging’ the old coil from your pod or tank and ‘plugging’ in a new one. The rubber seal on the coil ensures a secure fit, preventing leaks and making refills mess-free every time. Available in a variety of resistances and builds, PnP coils cater to a wide range of preferences. Whether you’re chasing dense clouds with high wattages for a rich and smooth DL (Direct Lung) experience, or prefer the precise flavour and satisfaction of an MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) inhale, there’s a PnP coil perfectly suited to your Voopoo device. With the ever-expanding PnP coil range, we recommend starting with the same type of coil that came with your original Voopoo vape kit to avoid confusion. However, feel free to experiment with other coils, ensuring their resistance (measured in ohms) matches your device’s capabilities. For instance, a low-resistance coil like the VM5 0.2ohm is ideal for a high-powered device such as the Voopoo Drag X, whereas a high-resistance coil like the TR1 1.2ohm works well with a low-powered device like the Voopoo Vinci series. When selecting an e-liquid for your Voopoo PnP coil, the following guideline is helpful: MTL coils pair best with Classic/High PG, 50/50, or Nicotine Salt e-liquids. DL coils (sub-ohm) are optimised for High-VG e-liquids. This adaptability ensures Voopoo PnP coils meet the needs of both new and seasoned vapers alike.
